audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-5 showed K'Sante/K'Sante/Skill/Skill/K'Sante while every matching why on the same page says Kled owns those stages ('Mounted Kled spikes at 2 ... out-bullying you', 'His full mounted kit out-trades you', 'keeps the trade edge through 4-5', 'still edge the lane', 'out-grind your Iceborn Gauntlet durability').
audit.why: 47.45% over 451 games, and the already-audited mirror set the chart to Skill, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, Kled, K'Sante with ratings 5/7/8/7/7/6/4 from Kled's side.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 set to Kled in phases[].side and win[] together, ratings inverted to 3/2/3/3/4 and row 6 raised to 6/10. Row 0 (Skill) and row 6 (K'Sante) already agreed and were left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Bear Trap on a Rope was called 'his engage hook' with no cooldown and no range, and Chaaaaaaaarge!!! had no number anywhere.
audit.why: Bear Trap is 11/10/9/8/7s at 800 range against your 450 — the range gap is why he opens every trade. Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140/125/110s, the longest window on either side.
audit.corrected: 11/10/9/8/7s and the 800-vs-450 range gap written into the cooldown block and dosFull[0].d; 140/125/110s into the interactions row; Path Maker's 14s into wants.you[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors. (1) 'dismounted Q pull' in four paths — when dismounted, Bear Trap on a Rope is REPLACED by Pocket Pistol, a ranged blast that knocks Kled BACKWARD. The pull only exists while he is mounted, so the page tells you to fear the pull in exactly the state where it does not exist. (2) 'W's unstoppable charge' / 'unstoppable threshold' in four paths — Riot's Path Maker text says reduced damage taken, never unstoppable. (3) 'Q3-knockup' / 'Q3 range' — Ntofo Strikes has no knockup and no third cast; at 2 stacks it fires a shockwave that pulls, from 450.
audit.why: Kit text is the authority, and the mirror recorded the same two-stack-pull and unstoppable problems from Kled's side.
audit.corrected: Pull reattributed to mounted Bear Trap throughout, dismounted phase described as courage restore and remount, W described as charge-up damage reduction, Ntofo named at its real 450 range. Chaaaaaaaarge!!!'s shield added as the thing to force out before committing, and Violent Tendencies' auto reset added as the burst tell.

edits.before: My armor stacking does nothing against a fed snowballing Kled in the sidelane, and his first bruiser item plus remount sustain out-grinds my Iceborn durability one-on-one — he's the scaler in any solo skirmish, so I don't duel him alone. My reclaim is the teamfight from two items: Path Maker's (W) unstoppable charge tanks his Chaaaaaarge! engage and the wall-stun locks him, then All Out's (R) recall yanks him off my carry the instant he dives. I close on my level 6 / teamfight peel windows and let his early kill pressure mean nothing in a 5v5 where I out-position him.
edits.after: My armor stacking does nothing against a fed snowballing Kled in the sidelane, and his first bruiser item plus a Skaarl remount out-grinds my Iceborn durability one-on-one — he's the scaler in any solo skirmish, so I don't duel him alone. My reclaim is the teamfight from two items: Path Maker's (W) charge-up damage reduction eats his Chaaaaaaaarge!!! engage and the wall-stun locks him, then All Out's (R) yank pulls him off my carry the instant he dives. I close on my level 6 / teamfight peel windows and let his early kill pressure mean nothing in a 5v5 where I out-position him.

notes: suspectNames flagged "Path Maker's" and "All Out's" in late — both FALSE POSITIVES, they are possessives of the correct names. The biggest real error was the reverse: 'dismounted Q pull' appearing four times, when dismounted Kled has Pocket Pistol (a self-knockback) and no pull at all. Whether Bear Trap's yank can be Flash-cancelled or QSS'd is not in the kit data and was not asserted.
